title: 深海の記憶、静かな回路
author: 鏡 ミライ

en.title: Memories of the Deep Sea, Silent Circuits
en.premise: In an age where emotion simulators allow people to virtually relive lost family memories, an engineer named Kai takes on the task of repairing an ancient memory device recovered from sunken ruins deep beneath the ocean. Within it lies an 'irrational sadness' that even the most advanced AI cannot decipher. In a world made too convenient, this is a story of searching for a pain that can truly be felt.

zh.title: 深海记忆，静谧回路
zh.premise: 在一个可以通过情感模拟器虚拟体验失落家族记忆的时代，技术员凯承接了一项任务，负责修复从沉没海底遗迹中回收的旧记忆装置。然而，装置中竟刻录着连高级AI都无法解析的“不合理的悲伤”。在这个过于便利的世界里，这是一个寻找被遗忘的、真实触感的痛苦的故事。
